title: I built a browser roguelite space shooter where you fight waves of AI drones and bosses named after tech giants (OGPT, Claudus, Grokkler)
author: coffeykoi33-
selftext:
Hey everyone! I wanted to share **Humans VS** [**AI.IO**](http://AI.IO) ([https://www.humansvsai.io](https://www.humansvsai.io?utm_source=gemini)), a fast-paced browser roguelite space shooter built to run seamlessly as a single-page web app.

Since the entire premise revolves around fighting rogue AI, I leaned heavily into using AI tools throughout the development process—and I wanted to share a bit about that workflow for anyone else building in this space.

**How AI Shaped the Development Experience:**

* **Architecting the Game Loop & Waves:** I used AI assistants to help rapidly scaffold the state machine for the wave-to-boss progression, letting me quickly iterate on how common, rare, and legendary upgrades scale dynamically during a run.
* **Balancing the Boss Roster:** Designing 9 unique tech-parody bosses—ranging from **OGPT** and **Eyes of Gemini** to **Claudus**, **Grokkler**, **Byte Dancer**, **Alexus Prime**, **Replicator**, and **Copilotron**—presented balancing challenges. I used local LLM passes to brainstorm distinct projectile patterns and movement behavior profiles for each so they didn't just feel like standard reskins.
* **The Pitfalls:** The biggest challenge was managing performance bottlenecks in the browser canvas while keeping the asset pipeline lightweight. Relying blindly on generated code often bloated the bundle size, forcing me to hand-optimize rendering loops and clean up state management.

The game is entirely free to play right in the browser with no downloads required. Going to eventually add multiplayer so it is a legitimate .io game. Also take the game for what it is.

I’d love to hear from other devs here: *How are you incorporating AI into your rapid prototyping workflows, and what has been your biggest headache when trying to keep browser performance smooth?* Happy to dive into the technical stack or chat about the build!
